title: ANTONBLAST - The Backflow Boogie 🚰 ~ The Hammer & The Mace ...in Slowroast Sewer (Roper-mix)
description:
❝ IT'S HAPPY HOUR! ❞
ㅤ- Anton, Antonblast (2024)



Did an arrangement of the 2nd stage theme The Hammer & The Mace ...in Slowroast Sewer from ANTONBLAST
(ft. Ropes 'n Roper from Battletoads & Double Dragon: The Ultimate Team)
. Wanted to give another shot at an indie platformer theme, especially after falling in love with ANTONBLAST last year, and Slowroast Sewer is easily my favorite stage from the game (with my favorite stage theme as well).

Thought the song sounded very similar to that of BT&DD's Stage 3 theme, so I thought it'd be fun to mash those two up for this mix for double the funk!!!

Important:
ㅤ♠ "Bonus End" & P-Switch are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. A Minor (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. A# Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
ㅤ3. G# Minor (Custom Pitch 2)
ㅤ4. F# Minor (Custom Pitch 3)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Original Echo Delay, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (OG Echo)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. Decreased Echo Delay & Disables Glass Break (Glass Break DISABLED)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ3. No Echo Delay (NO Echo)
